name: com.pluggableai.fanmeter.controller.activities.FanmeterPromptActivity
description: PluggableAI Fanmeter briefly opens this screen when it needs location access or a location setting for event participation. It launches the Android permission or settings prompt and returns control to Fanmeter after the user responds.
disableEffect: Fanmeter cannot request these location permissions or complete location setup, so event participation that needs location access may fail.
